plan.summary: BRO-5562 (part d): The Great Society (2019) and Torch Song (2018) were commercial productions recorded as nonprofit: Playbill says The Great Society was not an LCT production and its Form D shows $4.3M from 38 investors; Torch Song LLC raised investor money and the NYT reported it had not recouped. Both become Flop. Chicago and Sweeney Todd (2023) no longer read "Not publicly announced": their sources report the recoupment (New York Theatre Guide; BroadwayWorld). Into the Woods keeps it, with Broadway Journal quoted saying it did not announce.
steps: Edits read every oldValue from live data; every quote was opened at its URL.
